bibliographic.title: Criterio
bibliographic.author: Emilce Fabricio, Sebastián Vansteenkiste
bibliographic.description:
ES|EN

ES:

"Criterio" es una historia interactiva corta, realizada como -extremadamente- humilde homenaje dedicado a Pablo Tonello, dentro del marco de la #jam4life.

Fue escrita por Emilce Fabricio y desarrollada en #twine por Sebastián Vansteenkiste.

-------------------------------------------------

EN:

"Criterio" (Spanish for "criterion") is a short interactive story developed as an -extremely- humble homage dedicated to Pablo Tonello, joining the spirit of Jam4Life.

It was written by Emilce Fabricio and developed in Twine by Sebastián Vansteenkiste.

Due to time constraints, it's only available in Spanish at the moment, an English version may be added in the future.
